glosses: A tree or shrub of the genus Castanea.
A nut of such trees or shrubs or of similar ones.
A dark, reddish-brown colour, as seen on the fruit of the chestnut tree.

examples.text: Lord Carington […] led the way with his chestnuts […]
[…] browns are the soberest, bays are the worst tempered, and chestnuts are the most foolish.

glosses: An old joke; a worn-out meme, phrase, ploy, etc. so often repeated as to have grown tiresome or ineffective (often in the phrase \"old chestnut\").

examples.text: Yep, this is a dance-leaning cover of the Matthew Wilder '80s pop chestnut. It has already saturated radio airwaves throughout Europe, with a number of programmers here already giving it positive feedback.
Take greed. He’s been cited many times for what now has become a chestnut: “The point is, you can’t be too greedy.”

glosses: A round or oval horny plate found on the inner side of the leg of a horse or other animal, similar to a birthmark on a human.
